string.text: Memory multiplier. (If NPC already saw target then NPC will receive boost to their vision against this target. Decreases with time, with default value of 1.0 it takes around 100 real-life seconds for NPC to drop their boost to 0 against this target) \n \n Default: 1.0
Distance multiplier. (Distance from object to object, range and fov) \n \n Default: 1.0
Night vision of NPCs that own NVGs (higher-rank stalkers, marked by a visible dot at night). Higher = they see you better in the dark. "0" disables the NVG system. \n \n Default: 1.0
When enabled, an NPC that sees another NPC with an active flashlight from afar gets a brief vision boost. Adds immersion but may reduce FPS on maps with many NPCs. Off by default.
Recommended to enable this if you use Michiko's weather.

Displaying equation variables (for correct threshold you have to keep cursor on object all the time): 
 
 Console: all variables 
 
 Dynamic news: if object see actor or not 
 
 Bottom of the screen message: visibility threshold of object (and variables that you can change in MCM)
Write a dedicated log file (logs/stealth_overhaul.log) with detection and noise events. Useful for debugging.
Enable the footstep noise system. Movement, armor, weight, bleeding and rain all affect how far NPCs can hear you. NPCs investigate suspicious noises.
Show the blue noise-level bar under the HUD icon. Disable to hide it while keeping the noise system active.
Key to toggle the noise bar visibility in-game without opening the menu. Set to 0 in MCM to unbind it.
Global multiplier for the footstep noise radius. Higher = easier to hear you.
When AlifeTactics is installed with its movement-noise enabled, hostile stalkers' footstep alerts are delegated to it (no double alerting). Disable to always use this mod's own noise radii.

Only NPCs whose faction is hostile to you react to your footsteps. Neutrals and friends ignore them and won't go on alert when you walk or run nearby. Item-drop noise and monster alarms still alert everyone.
Mutants detect a bleeding actor faster. They can smell blood.
Pointing your flashlight directly at an NPC's face dazzles them (they see you worse), but the light gives away your position.
NPCs that were recently in bright light adapt slower to the darkness.
Military and mercenaries are more alert than bandits or ecologists.
NPCs wearing night vision devices see better at night.
Knife + crouch + undetected target + from behind = instant silent kill.
Crouch next to a fresh corpse while facing it to hide it. Hidden corpses are never found by other stalkers.
When a monster spots you, it alarms nearby stalkers within this radius. "0" disables this alarm.
How long the alarm boost lasts for stalkers alarmed by a monster.
When an NPC spots you, squadmates within this radius get a detection boost. "0" disables this alert.
How long the detection boost lasts for squadmates.

When AlifeTactics is installed, squadmates only learn your position after an attack if they can actually see you or are already fighting you. Prevents the whole squad from magically knowing where you are after an unseen hit. Disable to restore AT's stock disclosure behavior.
